statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118747 (GHSA-vmv3-wvjp-wqpj) is a .NET denial of service: colliding CBOR map keys can hash-flood the uniqueness checks in System.Formats.Cbor, and the fix switches them to seeded Marvin hashing. Microsoft lists System.Formats.Cbor from 10.0.0 up to but not including 10.0.15 as affected and 10.0.15 as fixed (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-vmv3-wvjp-wqpj, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/501, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.15/10.0.15.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries; 10.0.15-r0 is built from the dotnet/dotnet v10.0.115 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v10.0.115). Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0 through 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside their nupkg and tar.gz archives. Every build carries System.Formats.Cbor.dll in the ASP.NET Core shared framework of aspnetcore10-runtime, in the SDK, runtime packs and ASP.NET Core runtime archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, in nupkg files of dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, and as a reference assembly in aspnetcore10-targeting-pack, and every copy is from the same .NET servicing release as its build: 10.0.2 through 10.0.14 in the earlier builds and 10.0.15 in both 10.0.15-r0 builds. The range ends at 10.0.15-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-118747 (GHSA-vmv3-wvjp-wqpj) is a .NET denial of service: colliding CBOR map keys can hash-flood the uniqueness checks in System.Formats.Cbor, and the fix switches them to seeded Marvin hashing. Microsoft lists the independently versioned System.Formats.Cbor package from 8.0.0 up to but not including 8.0.2 as affected and 8.0.2 as fixed, and the .NET 8.0.34 release ships System.Formats.Cbor 8.0.2 (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-vmv3-wvjp-wqpj, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/501, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.34/8.0.34.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries; 8.0.34-r0 is built from the dotnet/dotnet v8.0.134 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v8.0.134). Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside their nupkg archives. The only implementation of System.Formats.Cbor in them is the System.Formats.Cbor NuGet package held by dotnet8-runtime-artifacts: version 8.0.0 in 8.0.23-r0 through 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.1 in 8.0.32-r0 and 8.0.33-r0, and 8.0.2 in 8.0.34-r0. The .NET 8 shared frameworks in these packages do not include System.Formats.Cbor.dll; the only other copy is a reference assembly, without implementation code, in an API documentation package. The range ends at 8.0.34-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-118747 (GHSA-vmv3-wvjp-wqpj) is a .NET denial of service in System.Formats.Cbor: CBOR map keys chosen to collide can hash-flood the reader's duplicate-key checks; the fix switches those checks to seeded Marvin hashing. Microsoft lists System.Formats.Cbor 10.0 as affected before 10.0.15 and fixed in 10.0.15, shipped with .NET 10.0.15 (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-vmv3-wvjp-wqpj, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.15/10.0.15.md). DHI dotnet-sdk-10 for Debian 13 repackages Microsoft's prebuilt .NET SDK for Linux, and each build's version starts with the SDK version it carries. Its published builds are 10.0.301-0, 10.0.302-0, 10.0.302-1, 10.0.400-1, 10.0.401-0, 10.0.401-1, 10.0.402-0, 10.0.403-0, 10.0.404-0 and 10.0.404-1. We unpacked every published dotnet-sdk-10 and dotnet-sdk-10-oci-config package for amd64 and arm64 (checksums verified against the repository index), including the nupkg and zip archives inside them. Each dotnet-sdk-10 package holds two copies of System.Formats.Cbor.dll: the implementation in the ASP.NET Core shared framework, /usr/lib/dotnet/shared/Microsoft.AspNetCore.App/<version>/, and a reference assembly in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref targeting pack, which holds API signatures and no implementation code; no archive inside the packages holds another copy, and the oci-config packages hold two configuration files and no .NET assemblies. In 10.0.301-0 through 10.0.403-0 the shared framework is ASP.NET Core 10.0.9 through 10.0.14 and its System.Formats.Cbor.dll reports that version and has no Marvin hashing; in 10.0.404-0 and 10.0.404-1, on both architectures, it is 10.0.15 and the assembly reports 10.0.15 and uses Marvin hashing. The range ends at 10.0.404-0, the first published build with the fix.
